text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's Valentine's Day, a day to gift friendship, love, and gratitude to those special someones in the form of chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer, do you have a minute?
choice_data_list: What's up?
What's up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Nothing. It's just… Well, today's Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You've been looking out for me since my debut, so… it's only polite to properly thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I wanted to give you something as thanks for all the help you've given me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's from a famous store, so it should taste good.
choice_data_list: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: There you are, Dober! I had a feeling you would be here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I have a favor to ask. Could you teach me how to make chocolates, please?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Anyway, that's why you can't warm up chocolate directly in a pot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, so that's what the double boiler method is! I shall remember this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ugh… You shouldn't have waited until the day of to come to me about this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: You're right. What a careless goose I am!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hang on. I know why we're here, but why are you making chocolates too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wait a second. You didn't have to go out of your way to hang out with us, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: It's more fun to make chocolates together, isn't it?
choice_data_list: I want to show my gratitude with chocolates too.
I want to show my gratitude with chocolates too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: It's more fun to make chocolates together, isn't it?
choice_data_list: I want to show my gratitude with chocolates too.
I want to show my gratitude with chocolates too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh. So you have someone you want to thank too…
choice_data_list: Do you want to know who they're for?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I guess that's fine, then… Are you making them for the director or Tazuna or someone?
choice_data_list: Do you want to know who they're for?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: A-as if! Stop saying weird things and get back to work!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That look… You're teasing me, aren't you? It's fine. You don't have to tell me. Let's just get back to work, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I did it! Thanks, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I did it! Thanks, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You're welcome. You two did great.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Now all I have to do is give these to Ryan and the others, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But what?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I made too many pieces. Why don't we try some of them now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: We can trade the chocolates we made with each other! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: H-hold on a sec!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'll just help myself to the pieces you two made!
choice_data_list: Is it okay if I have one of your chocolates, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What?! Wait, I'm not emotionally prepared for this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Um… Sure, if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No, wait! I mean… Agh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: They're not exactly store brand quality, so don't expect too much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Whatever! Have some if you'd like! I have no idea if they taste any good, though!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I don't have anyone to give them to, so take as many as you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her hesitation, Mejiro Dober's cheeks turn faintly pink as she puts a piece of chocolate I made in her mouth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think I'll give her the chocolates I made for her later…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I was hoping to give some chocolates to both of you before I gave any to Ryan and the others, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: There's someone else you'd both like to gift your chocolates to first aside from me, yes?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I won't be so boorish as to ruin your moment. I shall take my leave now! Do not mind my tears!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: W-wait a second. Was this your plan from the beginning?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'll come back to give you your chocolates later.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Urgh… Briiight!
choice_data_list: I guess it's just us now…
I guess it's just us now…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: D-don't say it like that! It makes me feel even more—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You don't have to mind what Bright said earlier.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: More what? Ugh, I'm such an idiot!
choice_data_list: Here, have something sweet to help you calm down.
You're the one I want to give my chocolates to, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Your chocolates came out really well, Trainer. I'm sure whoever you give them to will be happy to receive them.
choice_data_list: Here, have something sweet to help you calm down.
You're the one I want to give my chocolates to, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Something sweet? Wait, do you mean like chocolate?
choice_data_list: Happy Valentine's Day! Er, sorry they're so ugly.
They're not very pretty, but I put my feelings into these.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: M-me?!
choice_data_list: Happy Valentine's Day! Er, sorry they're so ugly.
They're not very pretty, but I put my feelings into these.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-wh—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: How are you able to do the things I can't so easily?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm so pathetic… And here I'd tried to get away with giving you store-bought chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's not fair…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Thanks. You're right. It's the feelings that count.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh. I feel like an idiot for trying to take the easy way out…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I know I've already given you some chocolates, but will you accept these, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Take these. I'm only giving them to you because I don't want to be the only one who gets chocolates pushed on her, got it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: They're not as nice as store-bought chocolates, but I did my best while making them.
